What are the percentage marks obtained by Mohan?
solution:
**Calculations:**

As these are the percentage obtained 

Marks obtained by Mohan in Chemistry

⇒ Marks obtained = 300 x 70% = 300 x 70/100 = 3 x 70 = 210

Marks obtained by Mohan in Mathematics

⇒ Marks obtained = 300 x 75% = 300 x 75/100 = 3 x 75 = 225

Marks obtained by Mohan in Physics

⇒ Marks obtained = 150 x 80% = 150 x 80/100 = 15 x 8 = 120

Marks obtained by Mohan in Hindi

⇒ Marks obtained = 300 x 65% = 300 x 65/100 = 3 x 65 = 195

Marks obtained by Mohan in English

⇒ Marks obtained = 200 x 85% = 200 x 85/100 = 2 x 85 = 170

⇒ Marks Mohan by obtained = 210 + 225 + 120 + 195 + 170 = 920

⇒ Total marks = 300 + 300 + 150 + 300 + 200 = 1250

⇒ The percentage obtained by Mohan = (Marks space obtained)/(Total space marks)times 100=(920)/(1250)times 100=73.6\%

⇒ **Hence, The percentage Mohan obtained is 73.6%**
